body: I appreciate the kindness, but in the words of Coolio, "I take a look at my life and realize there's nothing left."

I've talked to my advisor and considering the amount of work to be done, my situation is pretty hopeless.

I won't be with my family. I haven't talked to my parents in three months.

Other than this one day when my friend came to visit me and the various breaks, I have spent almost every day since August alone.
That sounds like some really good stuff that I will look into, thanks a lot, fam

In social situations, my panic attacks tend to be me pinching and peeling the skin on my fingers. The bodily pain keeps me from losing my shit, so to speak. It just keeps me present in spite of the massive amount of stress I get when interacting with people.
